'''May 2000 Salt Lake City tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mind Games, Salt Lake City, Utah on 3 May 2000. [[Nathan Magro]] won it. It is known from Matthew Jensen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d667">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200d667/ salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 4 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200d667/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Mind Games, Salt Lake City, Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Nathan Magro]]
